svg.text: Sanad: three agents, one safety kernel, durable infrastructure

g.text: doctor box + patient box + board + feed
Cloud Run service sanad, stateless per request
plain Python, NO model in this decision
code validates loop types and required fields
the doctor taps Confirm or Cancel
Patient path: the safety kernel, in the order code runs it
would the doctor want to be woken now?
add-only, fails closed to a relay
acts only through the Coordinator's tools
no tools at all (output_schema + tools is
disallowed in ADK 2.8.0); the plan and the open
loops are injected as text by code
no-reassurance list, then every number traced
to a plan number of the same class
Escalation: canned ER block to the patient
plus a red card to the doctor
compared in code vs target / baseline / critical
core/verify.py: name, collection date, every analyte
run id, quiet hours, one a day, the ladder
the ledger is claimed before the agent thinks
seven guarded tools, one action per wake-up
every tool call is checked before it runs
a refusal goes back with its reason

svg.text: the emergency block, and the red card
read at boot and per request
Node for node the mermaid block in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. The numbers on the patient path are the order code runs the gates in; a model never decides whether a gate runs.
